JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A dual-language journal entry written by a user with AI translation and extracted root vocabulary.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this journal entry.

originalText.description: The original journal entry text written in the source language.

translatedText.description: The AI-translated text in the target language.

sourceLanguage.description: ISO language code of the original entry (en or ar).

targetLanguage.description: ISO language code of the target translation (en or ar).

vocabulary.description: Bounded list of extracted vocabulary items (max 50 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated.

Flashcard.title: Flashcard
Flashcard.description: An SM-2 spaced repetition flashcard containing conjugated target vocabulary and its Arabic triliteral root or English base form.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this flashcard.

entryId.description: The ID of the parent JournalEntry from which this word was extracted.

wordConjugated.description: Target language word in its conjugated or inflected form.

root.description: Base form or Arabic triliteral root (e.g., ش ر ي).

context.description: Short context phrase from the journal entry.

isNew.description: True if the card has not been reviewed yet; prioritized in the daily SRS queue.

nextReviewDate.description: ISO date string for the next scheduled SM-2 review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the flashcard was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the flashcard was last updated.

/journalEntries/{entryId}.description: Stores user journal entries with translations and extracted vocabulary.

/flashcards/{cardId}.description: Stores user SM-2 spaced repetition flashcards linked to journal entries.
